title: Fusion power — the solved star-fire
description: Level 1's engine: controlled fusion — the star-fire solved on Earth (projection).
body: Fusion power — fusing light nuclei as stars do — is the defining solved technology of a level-1 civilization: energy at the planetary scale, from seawater fuel. Humanity has demonstrated fusion energy gain (NIF, 2022) but not yet a power plant; level 1 is achieved when fusion is routine. Projection, labeled as such.
